title: net2 gate replication: round 7e's passing candidate on validation campaign seed 11
description: Round 7e's candidate at teacher gain 0.5 (release model-net2-r7e05-cands) passed its gate on the validation links with campaign seed 21 (exp-net2-gate-r7e05-133), one of 19 gates there, and on the test links matched the fixed rule in every family, beating it with Cubic from the start (exp-net2-test-r7e-k0.5-134), while its competition gain shrank from +0.054 to +0.019. Round 8's sharper students did worse at the same gate (exp-net2-gate-r8e05-136). This runs the same candidate, unchanged, through the same gate on the same validation links with campaign seed 11, new episodes chosen by nothing, to measure how much of its pass was luck. It selects nothing: the result is reported whatever it is. It runs next to the fixed rule on net1 v5 (u = 0.25, release model-net1v5) and BBRv3 on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s, scored by experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py as at the gate. Validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/m" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$IN/m/net1v5.pt" --u0 0.25 --k 0.5 1; P=(--policy "rule-v5=$IN/m/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k0.5.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k1.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 11 11 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 11 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT"
